newsitem.title: USA: American Management says dispute hurt net.
newsitem.headline: American Management says dispute hurt net.

text.p: American Management Systems said on Wednesday its reduced its reported 1996 income by $18.3 million due to failure to reach agreement on a major program with an unnamed client.

The company said that since it released its financial results on February 20, this client "has taken positions that in management's judgment make it improbable that a resolution of the issues can be made on the basis of management's previous estimates."

American Management reduced reported 1996 net income from $33.8 million, or $0.81 per share, to $15.5 million, or $0.37 per share. That compares to 1995 net income of $29.2 million, or $0.72 per share.
The company said it is confident that the impact of the problem has been absorbed, and that the company's financial situation remains strong.
American Management is a business and information technology consulting firm.
